settings.title: Settings
settings.notSignedIn: Not signed in — notes stay on this device.
settings.aiDefault: AI on new notes by default
settings.aiDisclosure: AI needs plaintext. When AI is on for a note, its text is sent over TLS to our Supabase Edge Functions and to the AI providers (Anthropic, Moonshot/Kimi, OpenAI) to be processed; it is not stored there. An embedding of the note (a list of numbers) is stored in Pinecone to power search. Notes with AI off are never sent anywhere unencrypted.
settings.providerProOnly: Choosing a provider is a Pro feature.
settings.recoveryKeyBody: This key decrypts your synced notes. Store it somewhere safe; you'll need it on a new device.
settings.importKeyBody: Paste the recovery key from your other device. This replaces this device's key.
settings.undecryptable: {{count}} synced items couldn't be decrypted with this device's key.
settings.deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your account, synced notes and search index, and erases this device's notes. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteLocalBody: Deletes all notes stored on this device. Synced copies are not affected.
